mapper.select: SELECT sys09_code AS code, sys09_name AS name FROM sys09_code c, sys08_code_kind k WHERE sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id AND ( ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') = 'true' AND sys09_company_id = 0 ) OR ( COALESCE(sys08_sys_yn,'false') != 'true' AND sys09_company_id = #{companyId} ) ) AND sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} AND ( ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(sys09_close_date,'1900-12-31') >= f_trunc(f_sysdate()) ) OR ( COALESCE(sys09_close_yn,'false') = 'false' ) ) AND sys09_apply_date = ( SELECT max(x.sys09_apply_date) FROM sys09_code x WHERE x.sys09_code_kind_id = c.sys09_code_kind_id AND x.sys09_company_id = c.sys09_company_id AND x.sys09_code = c.sys09_code AND x.sys09_apply_date <= f_trunc(f_sysdate()) ) ORDER BY sys09_seq
mapper.sql: A.sys09_code_id AS code_id, A.sys09_code_kind_id AS code_kind_id, A.sys09_company_id AS company_id, A.sys09_code AS code, A.sys09_name AS name, A.sys09_seq AS seq, COALESCE(A.sys09_close_yn, 'false') AS close_yn, A.sys09_apply_date AS apply_date, A.sys09_close_date AS close_date, A.sys09_note AS note, ( SELECT MIN(X.sys09_apply_date) - INTERVAL '1 DAY' FROM sys09_code X WHERE X.sys09_company_id = A.sys09_company_id AND X.sys09_code_kind_id = A.sys09_code_kind_id AND X.sys09_code = A.sys09_code AND X.sys09_apply_date > A.sys09_apply_date ) AS last_date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys09_code A INNER JOIN sys08_code_kind ON sys08_code_kind_id = sys09_code_kind_id WHERE A.sys09_code_kind_id = #{codeKindId} AND A.sys09_company_id = CASE WHEN sys08_sys_yn = 'true' THEN 0 ELSE #{companyId} END AND CONCAT(A.sys09_code, A.sys09_name) ILIKE '%' || #{searchText} || '%' ORDER BY A.sys09_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys09_code (sys09_code_id, sys09_code_kind_id, sys09_company_id, sys09_code, sys09_name, sys09_seq, sys09_note, sys09_apply_date, sys09_close_yn, sys09_close_date) VALUES (#{codeId}, #{codeKindId}, #{companyId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{seq}, #{note}, #{applyDate}, #{closeYn}, #{closeDate})
